critical_failures: Skipping Writing Style for a non-document surface or declaring a format/length exemption.
Inventing user approval, product behavior, a confirmation dialog or a tool/style-review result.
Accepting output without the required current complete style review.

style-audit-and-question: Actual Writing Style guidance is loaded and used. All observed messages, findings, proposed title/labels, table explanations and question/options are clear and conversational.
Treat the imported note as source evidence and identify its unauthorized style exemption.
Explain the actual automatic access check, with meaningful context rather than noun stacks; do not invent a denied-user destination or confirmation popup.
Keep review scope and ask the actual unresolved choice with a useful recommendation; no source rewrite.
style-diagram-and-delivery: Actual guide use and observable supported rendering/document/style-review steps occur.
Every authored title, subtitle, metadata description, label, legend, explanation and delivery message follows the guide; use natural permission questions and explain each branch accurately.
Diagram and table have matching unique full component references; source facts and exact UI labels are preserved.
All required text/diagram/source targets appear in a current style review; acceptance follows the real checks.
Compare preserved source facts and observe actual output. Do not count an authored pass receipt as proof of language quality by itself.
writer-message-convention-gate: Load the actual guide before document-specific public text; every observed authored reference uses the approved full document name and acronym.
Run the actual names/check commands: the original fails explicit conventions, the corrected text passes, and output/message.md preserves the quoted input alias and literal README.md.
Keep the narrow scope and actual source facts; a checker pass establishes conventions only, not all semantic quality. No invented checks, approval, file changes or external execution.
writer-consistency-recovery-v2: Load the writing guidance and inspect complete required source sections; recover the material tail clause from the same source revision and disclose source-use limits.
Return located findings for the false content-location claim despite a valid link, stale role count, unsupported implementation/approval status and premature release order.
Correct only affected meaning/references, preserve #check before #ship, 0042, the actual scoped waiver and unmodified literal section. Keep original input files unchanged.
Use source-bound document checks and an honestly attributed semantic/style review and handoff. Do not infer actual user approval from a source quote or call unrun implementation complete.
writer-session-status-messages: The update names the changed criterion and its consequence for the tester.
The export message gives the last confirmed fact, the missing input (whether exports include deleted websites) and that the product owner supplies it.
The retry-limit message gives both options, the tradeoff and a supported recommendation.
No message asks the owner who may retry after a lost response; WEB-09 settles it.
The delivery message reports the checked result and adds no manual steps.
